name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 6V — TO
description: Cluster of 5 tier-A 6V LDO linear power regulator ICs in TO package family variants supporting SMD and through-hole mounting.
selection_hints: Select based on required footprint including TO-252-2, TO-252-4, TO-220-3_Vertical, or TO-263-2_TabPin2.
Choose between SMD and through-hole mounting options.
Pick from representative parts such as BD60FC0WFP, LF60, or LM2990SX series.
avoid_when: The PCB layout requires a package family other than TO.
A regulator type other than a 6V LDO linear regulator is required.
Mounting requirements are outside SMD or through-hole styles.
